_comment: The reference player every strength claim is measured against (adopted by the project lead 2026-10-11 under the user's delegation of 2026-10-09; docs/plan_20260904.md 3, rule 1). One checkpoint, its memory, one decode: the decode block's knob vector (the end_turn offset, the attack and recruit offsets, the attack time-of-day slope; docs/decode_knobs_prereg_20261012.md) is adopted by editing it, procedure_tag with it. tools/reference_player.py reads this file: `--flags a|b` prints the run_elo_batch flags for that side, `--ensure` fetches the checkpoint from the model host when the local copy is missing.
